plan.title: File explorer E: file actions, undo/redo, OS drop, drag to composer
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The explorer pane (PAN-5186) and code pane (PAN-5187) can read and edit files, but the tree has no way to create, rename, duplicate, move or delete entries, no undo, no upload from the OS, and no way to hand file paths to an agent's composer. The write RPCs already exist on the server (PAN-5187) and the upload route in PAN-5188.
narratives.Proposal: A frontend-only slice under components/explorer/actions/: write wrappers in the one RPC seam, a step-wise per-root undo stack ported from Orca, pure name/move rules, an actions core whose single runWrite seam every write goes through (PAN-5191 later wraps it for edit workspaces), an inline name row, menu/header/keyboard wiring, HTML5 drag move with hover expand and edge scroll, OS-drop upload through PAN-5188's client, and a composer drop that inserts root-relative paths at the caret. Project roots and the Changed view get no write actions. See .pan/drafts/pan-5190.md for decisions D-E1..D-E20.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Write actions on project: roots, and edit workspaces (PAN-5191).
- Write actions while the Changed filter is on.
- Moving entries between two different explorer roots.
- Uploading OS folders (walking their contents) or overwriting an existing file on upload.
- Byte-level upload progress.
- Path drops on any target other than ComposerFooter (SubagentComposer, AgentTellForm, terminals, external apps), and absolute paths in the drop.
- File copy/paste shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd+C/V) and a Ctrl/Cmd+D duplicate key.
- Persisting undo history across reloads.
- The user page features/file-explorer.mdx (PAN-5191).
- Any server, contract, RPC method, HTTP route or no-loss-matrix change.
- Recreating any PAN-5187 or PAN-5188 file (code-drafts, save queue, write handlers, explorer-http.ts) if those issues have not merged.

autoDecisions.summary: Project roots get no write actions in this issue; every write goes through one runWrite seam that PAN-5191 wraps (D-E1, D-E3).
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent WI-13 step 9 needs withEditWorkspace, which PAN-5191 builds and PAN-5191 depends on this issue; PAN-5186 D-B7 and PAN-5187 D-C12 set the same read-only precedent.

autoDecisions.summary: No write actions while the Changed filter is on (D-E2).
autoDecisions.rationale: Changed-view rows are synthesized from git status and can be deleted files or unlisted folders, so writes there are ambiguous.

autoDecisions.summary: Undo ops are step-wise; refusals (ALREADY_EXISTS, NOT_FOUND, INVALID_TARGET) keep the op for retry, other errors drop it (D-E4).
autoDecisions.rationale: Orca keeps refused ops; making ops step-wise keeps multi-item actions retryable without replaying steps that already ran.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete sends one explorerDelete call per top-level path (D-E6).
autoDecisions.rationale: trashPaths throws without returning the ids it already moved on a mid-batch failure; per-path calls keep every moved entry undoable.

autoDecisions.summary: Undo of create, duplicate and upload moves the file to the trash, and redo restores it (D-E7).
autoDecisions.rationale: Content written into a new file after creation survives an undo and redo round trip.

autoDecisions.summary: OS-drop folders are detected via webkitGetAsEntry().isDirectory only, without walking them (D-E16).
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent PRD rules out folder traversal; the flag is the only reliable signal that a dropped item is a folder.

autoDecisions.summary: The drag payload sets two custom MIME types and no text/plain (D-E15).
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps other dashboard text fields from accepting tree drags; the composer reads its own type.

autoDecisions.summary: PAN-5188 is treated as a dependency of the OS-drop item only; that item blocks until it merges.
autoDecisions.rationale: Only uploads need uploadExplorerFile; the rest of the issue can ship on PAN-5186 + PAN-5187.

metadata.sizeJustification: This is one child (WI-13) of an epic the parent PRD already split into seven issues. All code is one frontend surface: components/explorer/ plus one small composer hook, and about half of the ~40 files are co-located test files. The serialized chain exists because ExplorerPane.tsx is the single integration point; splitting into more sibling issues would serialize the same file across PRs and leave half-wired menus on main between them. Subsystem count is 5 (src/dashboard plus four root-level files).
